chapter: Family, Margaret's story and Eutris's memories
title: Professor Scott and the missionary Sunday school band
summary: A white professor from Agnes Scott College formed a band of five boys at the missionary Sunday school.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: What about one other thing? You said that - I forget the gentleman's name that you mentioned - who had formed 5 of them to play -
Professor Scott.
All right, Professor Scott was teaching at Morris Brown?
No, he wasn't. This was a white man.
He was teaching at Agnes Scott College.
Yes, he was one of the founders of Agnes Scott College.
How did they come in together?
They had a missionary Sunday school in the afternoon and it was taught by these missionaries. Professor Scott was in charge of them.
Yes, but how did he get to -
Get to Jay?
Just walked up on him and he took me in.
He formed this little band. He got these 5 boys together.
He got all the group together.

What I'm trying to do is get the introduction - how did he get to Professor Scott at Agnes Scott College? Because was it a thing that he went out and recruited them or did they usually go over to the missionary school?
They went to this missionary school, missionary Sunday school, on Sunday afternoon.
You said something about they were going there in the afternoon but you didn't say - I'm trying to figure out - you went to the missionary Sunday school?
Yes, we all did, all the girls and boys in that town. That's where they met.
And then they formed a band at the church. So he picked a group of 5 of them and wanted them to play an instrument. So he decided that he wanted to play trombone.
He picked the instrument he wanted.
Right, and you bought the instrument?
Yes.
O.K. Where did you find the instrument? Where did you buy it from?
Professor Scott. He bought all the instruments.
